root_cause: PR 7510 made the gateway read openclaw.runtime.json = {$include: ./openclaw.json, plugins...}. The pinned gateway (ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw:2026.7.1, io module preserveUntouchedIncludes) treats the whole root as $include-owned, so every config.patch that changes agents.list fails with 'Config write would flatten $include-owned config at <root>', breaking POST /consultation/agents/ensure (503).
reproduced_on: pantheon-openclaw-gateway:persona-tools-it (pinned 2026.7.1): real gateway started with the overlay, `gateway call config.patch` with the consult provisioning shape -> UNAVAILABLE 'Config write would flatten $include-owned config at <root>'
fix: No $include overlay. The persona-tools plugin is baked into the image as a stock (bundled-origin) plugin (/app/dist/extensions/pantheon-persona-tools) with enabledByDefault=true and manifest config optional; it reads PERSONA_TOOL_BROKER_URL / PERSONA_TOOL_BROKER_TOKEN from the gateway env and registers nothing without the token. OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH is never set; openclaw.json is a plain writable file. Startup deletes any legacy openclaw.runtime.json. consult_agent_provisioning.py is unchanged (its patch now succeeds as-is).
verified_with: PANTHEON_GATEWAY_TEST_IMAGE=pantheon-openclaw-gateway:persona-tools-it PANTHEON_GATEWAY_TEST_PLUGIN_DIR=<locally built plugin dir mounted at the stock path> python3 -m unittest scripts.test_openclaw_gateway_plugin_rollback_contract
result: 9 tests OK (static + docker tiers, real gateway); plugin unit tests 16/16 (npm test). The Dockerfile itself could not be built in the worker sandbox (docker build not permitted), so the image-baked placement is proven by mounting the identically built plugin at the Dockerfile's destination path; the deploy build is the final check.

acceptance.3_agent_survives: agent written via config.patch is returned by config.get after gateway restart and after rollback to the plugin-less image
acceptance.4_real_gateway: proof drives the pinned image's gateway process via `gateway call config.get/config.patch`, not a fake gateway_call
